# SplitSecure Provider

Terraform provider for managing SplitSecure resources. The provider signs in as a service account, either with a registered key (service_account_s2r, key_id and private_key) or with workload identity (service_account_s2r and a workload_identity block). Use one, not both.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) SplitSecure API endpoint URL. Can also be set with SPLITSECURE_ENDPOINT. Defaults to production.
- `key_id` (String) Required without workload_identity. Key id the console assigned when the public key was registered. Falls back to SPLITSECURE_KEY_ID.
- `org_s2r` (String) Org s2r URI hosting the team(s) that own the resources managed by this provider; the proposal-scoped managed enclave is spawned in this org for every Create / Delete. Falls back to SPLITSECURE_ORG_S2R. Multi-org callers alias the provider.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Required without workload_identity. PEM private key matching key_id: ECDSA P-256, P-384 or P-521, or Ed25519. RSA keys are refused. Falls back to SPLITSECURE_PRIVATE_KEY.
- `service_account_s2r` (String) Required. Service account s2r URI (s2r:<deployment>:sa:<id>). Falls back to SPLITSECURE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_S2R.
- `workload_identity` (Block, Optional) Sign in with an external OIDC token instead of a key. The service account needs a binding that matches the token. Leave the block empty inside GitHub Actions to use the job's ID token, which needs the id-token: write permission. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--workload_identity))

<a id="nestedblock--workload_identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workload_identity`

Optional:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) External OIDC token. Its aud claim must be the endpoint's origin. Falls back to SPLITSECURE_WORKLOAD_TOKEN. When unset, the GitHub Actions ID token is requested on every refresh.

## Examples

Each example creates a working cloud sign-in, both the SplitSecure and the cloud side. Its README says what to set and in what order.

- [`examples/aws-saml`](https://github.com/splitsecure/terraform-provider-splitsecure/tree/main/examples/aws-saml): sign in to an AWS role with SAML.
- [`examples/aws-oidc`](https://github.com/splitsecure/terraform-provider-splitsecure/tree/main/examples/aws-oidc): get AWS role sessions with OIDC tokens.
- [`examples/gcp-saml`](https://github.com/splitsecure/terraform-provider-splitsecure/tree/main/examples/gcp-saml): sign in to the Google Cloud console with SAML, through a workforce pool.
- [`examples/gcp-oidc`](https://github.com/splitsecure/terraform-provider-splitsecure/tree/main/examples/gcp-oidc): get Google Cloud service account tokens with OIDC tokens.
- [`examples/azure-saml`](https://github.com/splitsecure/terraform-provider-splitsecure/tree/main/examples/azure-saml): sign in to Entra ID as a user of a federated domain with SAML.
- [`examples/azure-oidc`](https://github.com/splitsecure/terraform-provider-splitsecure/tree/main/examples/azure-oidc): get Entra ID application tokens with OIDC tokens.
